Name: L_FootBox
Description: Create foot boxes geos for the foot block

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create foot boxes geos for the foot block.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Color: choose one option (for example: pink, orange, blue, light_blue).
- ForceYZero: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetToes: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetBallFloor: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: L_Foot_Ankle_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt.
- Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
